breakdown.combined_total_note: 318 is the combined coverage run of both suites; 143 + 175 = 318.

coverage.scope: src/** only, both suites together, Node --experimental-test-coverage, local PostgreSQL 18; client code is not measured

findings.title: A NUL character (U+0000) in free-text input returns HTTP 500 UNEXPECTED instead of 422 VALIDATION_FAILED
findings.root_cause: CONFIRMED: PostgreSQL error 22021 on U+0000 in a text parameter; validators accept the character and the error handler maps the unknown error to UNEXPECTED
findings.resolution: P07.3: rejectNulCharacters middleware (src/http/middleware.js, registered in src/app.js). Verified by re-execution: TEST-SEC-035 passes; 143/143 new, 175/175 existing, 318/318 combined.

findings.title: IMPLEMENTATION_INDEX.md is stale: FAIL/BLOCKED statuses and 192/193 test counts predate the integration of US-016/017/018/021/024; P07 now has passing evidence for AC-027, AC-033, AC-047 and AC-052
